_why: hr-accrue payload_sha256 -> the commit it was packed from. A CLAIM, recorded by the Coordinator at each hr-accrue deploy (the deploy already checks the live GET against `node tools/pack-edge.mjs hr-accrue --hash` at that commit). tools/lib/engine-pack.mjs re-packs the commit with ITS OWN packer and refuses the engine unless the hash matches, so a wrong entry stops tests/world-tick-combat-replay.mjs --live (exit 2); it can never replay a probe on the wrong code. Append one line per deploy; never edit an old line.
